items: The see-through round the witch no longer smears everything outside a hard circle on some graphics cards
The canopy cut-away round her is about a third smaller, and its size is a slider on the pause page (Canopy cut-away)
The pause page has a See-through group for the circle hunt: its reach and opacity as sliders, its fade on or off, and a switch that tints whatever the see-through draws magenta
